title: test_view_interaction.gd re-copies _press/_move/_release/_pair_with_arc helpers that already exist in test_gesture.gd
evidence:
tests/test_view_interaction.gd:277-286:
func _press(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var e := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	e.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
	e.pressed = true
	e.position = pos
	e.global_position = pos
	Input.parse_input_event(e)
	await tree.process_frame
	await tree.process_frame

tests/test_gesture.gd:96-105 is byte-identical (same _move at 107/288, same _release at 117/298, and _pair_with_arc at 134/258 differs only in `var best: Array = []` vs `var best = []`).
detail: Five input-synthesis helpers are duplicated across two new-ish test files; drift between copies would make gesture-path vs interaction-path tests silently test different event shapes.
recommended_fix: Hoist _press/_move/_release/_pair_with_arc (and optionally _sky_screen_point) into tests/test_base.gd or a shared test_input_harness.gd; both files reuse them.

title: REPLAY_CMDS 16-pair topology is hand-copied as a literal in capture_runner.gd, outside the shared-definition pattern
evidence:
tests/test_sim_base.gd:14-17 declares 'The replay-evidence command stream — ONE definition shared by tests/test_sim_replay.gd and tools/determinism_log.gd' with REPLAY_CMDS add_pipe pairs [1,0],[2,0],[3,0],[4,0],[0,9],[10,9],[12,9],[13,9],[9,11],[13,11],[15,11],[17,11],[11,22],[23,22],[25,22],[27,22]. scripts/capture_runner.gd:88-92 re-types the identical 16 pairs as a bare literal: 'for pair in [
		[1, 0], [2, 0], [3, 0], [4, 0],
		[0, 9], [10, 9], [12, 9], [13, 9],
		[9, 11], [13, 11], [15, 11], [17, 11],
		[11, 22], [23, 22], [25, 22], [27, 22],
	]:'
detail: The single-definition sharing works for the replay test and determinism log, but the 06/07 flow/QoS captures build their spine from a second hand-copied list — retuning REPLAY_CMDS leaves capture evidence silently diverged from replay evidence.
recommended_fix: Have capture_runner._e2_shots load the add_pipe pairs from tests/test_sim_base.gd's REPLAY_CMDS (like determinism_log.gd does) instead of re-typing the 16 pairs.
